title: I asked claude to make a simple game, read telementry and player feedback and ships fixes plus one design experiment every night... pretty interesting.
author: HermannPeterscheck
selftext:
Hi All,

I'm experimenting with closed improvement loops in games, so I had Claude recommend a few games ideas and build one. Then I added scoring (1-5) and feedback from players which feed into a nightly cron that an agent grabs and decides what to make next.

Those results are then posted back up and the loop continues.  
You can check the game, it's called Orbit Dash.

I find the game itself pretty fun, albeit simple, but I find the self improvement loop endlessly fascinating, especially which experiments it chooses, which improvements it makes.

I also post all the changes, stats and so on (And those also get feedback which then go into a separate closed improvement loop).

My goal here is to see what can be done when I remove myself from the judgement part. So much AI work is about trying to get the AI to "do what I want it to" I wanted to go in the opposite direction and get myself out of the way as much as possible.

Thanks!
